description: Server-side JavaScript code for an Express.js application that provides an API to connect to multiple databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, MongoDB), load environment variables, and serve static files. It includes classes for database adapters, connection testing, and API route handling.

classes.name: DatabaseAdapter
classes.description: Base class for database connection and data retrieval, with methods to test connection, get tables, and get data.

classes.name: SQLAdapter
classes.description: Abstract class extending DatabaseAdapter for SQL-based databases, providing execute, getTables, and getData methods.

classes.name: PostgresAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for PostgreSQL, implementing execute, getTableQuery, and getDataQuery.

classes.name: MySQLAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for MySQL, implementing execute, getTableQuery, and getDataQuery.

classes.name: SQLiteAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for SQLite, implementing execute, getTableQuery, and getDataQuery.

classes.name: MongoDBAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for MongoDB, implementing getTables and getData using MongoDB client.

methods.name: loadEnvFiles
methods.description: Loads environment variables from .env files for different databases.

methods.name: testConnections
methods.description: Tests connections to configured databases and returns list of available ones.

methods.name: handleApiRequest
methods.description: Generic handler for API requests, executing database operations and handling errors.
